qe: Before the discovery of electrons, scientists defined the direction of electric current based on the flow of positive charges. In modern circuit design, how is the conventional direction of electric current designated relative to actual charge carriers?
qh: इलेक्ट्रॉनों की खोज से पहले, वैज्ञानिकों ने धनात्मक आवेशों के प्रवाह के आधार पर विद्युत धारा की दिशा को परिभाषित किया था। आधुनिक सर्किट डिज़ाइन में, वास्तविक आवेश वाहकों के सापेक्ष विद्युत धारा की पारंपरिक दिशा को कैसे निर्दिष्ट किया जाता है?
o: It flows exclusively from a lower electric potential to a higher electric potential channel.
It is conventionally taken as opposite to the direction of the flow of electrons.
It shifts dynamically depending on the macroscopic cross-sectional area of the wire.
It aligns perfectly parallel to the drift velocity vector of negative electrons.
e: Concept: Pehle logon ko electron ke baare me pata nahi tha, isliye unhone current ki direction positive charge ke flow ki tarah maan li thi - isi ko 'conventional current' kehte hain. Electron ki khoj ke baad pata chala ki asli charge carriers (electron) ulti taraf chalte hain, par purani convention aaj bhi chal rahi hai. Isliye circuit design me conventional current ko electron ke flow ke opposite maana jata hai. Doosre options galat hain kyunki current ka direction wire ke cross-section area par nahi, sirf charge flow ke hisaab se hota hai. Exam point: 'Conventional current = electron ke flow ke opposite'.

qe: An ammeter is a standard instrument used to track the magnitude of electric current traversing a circuit. To ensure an accurate measurement without altering the circuit parameters, how must it be connected?
qh: एक एमीटर एक मानक उपकरण है जिसका उपयोग सर्किट से गुजरने वाले विद्युत धारा के परिमाण को मापने के लिए किया जाता है। सर्किट मापदंडों को बदले बिना सटीक माप सुनिश्चित करने के लिए, इसे कैसे जोड़ा जाना चाहिए?
o: It is always connected in series in the circuit through which the current is to be measured.
It must be oriented at an orthogonal angle of 90 degrees relative to the cell terminals.
It must always be connected in parallel across the specific target gadget.
It is connected in a bridged configuration only when the circuit is open.
e: Concept: Ammeter ka kaam circuit me behte current ki value naapna hai. Current naapne ke liye ammeter ko usi raste me aana padta hai jisse current guzarta hai, isliye ise hamesha series me lagate hain aur iska resistance bahut kam (ideal: zero) rakha jata hai taaki circuit ke current me koi badlav na aaye. Agar ise parallel me lagaya jaye to wo bahut kam resistance ke kaaran short circuit bana dega aur current bina load ke behne lagega. Exam point: 'Ammeter = series me, low resistance'.

qe: Electric charges do not flow through a copper wire by themselves, just as water in a perfectly horizontal tube does not flow. To initiate and sustain a current, what physical condition is mandatory along the conductor?
qh: विद्युत आवेश किसी तांबे के तार में अपने आप प्रवाहित नहीं होते, ठीक वैसे ही जैसे एक पूर्णतः क्षैतिज नली में पानी प्रवाहित नहीं होता। धारा को प्रारंभ करने और बनाए रखने के लिए, चालक के अनुदिश कौन सी भौतिक स्थिति अनिवार्य है?
o: There must be a difference of electric pressure, called the potential difference, along the conductor.
The total internal chemical energy matrix must drop to absolute zero.
The conductor must undergo immediate mechanical polarization at its boundaries.
The gravitational acceleration vector must align parallel to the wire axis.
e: Concept: Electric charge khud se nahi behta, bilkul jaise seedhi nali me paani khud nahi behta. Current shuru karne aur banaye rakhne ke liye conductor ke do siro ke beech electric 'pressure' ka farq hona zaroori hai - isi ko potential difference (voltage) kehte hain. Battery ya cell apne andar rasayanik kriya se yahi farq bana deti hai. Bina is farq ke electron random hi hilte rehte hain, ek disha me nahi behte. Doosre options me gravitational lazz, polarization waghera ka is process se lena-dena nahi; ye galat karan hain. Exam point: 'Current behta hai jab potential difference ho'.

qe: When no current is being drawn from an electric cell, what is the status of the potential difference across its terminals generated by the internal chemical actions?
qh: जब किसी विद्युत सेल से कोई धारा नहीं ली जा रही होती है, तो आंतरिक रासायनिक क्रियाओं द्वारा उसके टर्मिनलों पर उत्पन्न विभवांतर (potential difference) की स्थिति क्या होती है?
o: The potential difference transforms into an alternate transverse magnetic field tensor.
The potential difference remains actively generated across the terminals even when no current is drawn.
The value fluctuates rapidly as a function of the external environment pressure.
The potential difference collapses instantly to absolute zero.
e: Concept: Jab cell se koi current nahi liya jata (open circuit), tab bhi uske andar ki rasayanik kriya apna kaam kar rahi hoti hai aur terminal ke beech potential difference bana rehta hai. Isi halat me us value ko cell ka 'EMF' kehte hain. Current lene par ye value thodi kam ho jati hai (internal resistance ke kaaran). Isliye 'no current' ka matlab terminal voltage zero nahi hota. Doosre options me field me badalna ya pressure se fluctuate hona - ye sab galat hain. Exam point: 'Open circuit par bhi terminal potential difference (EMF) present rehta hai'.

qe: The potential difference between two points in a current-carrying conductor is defined as the work done to move a unit charge from one point to the other. What is the alternative dimensional configuration of its SI unit, the Volt (V)?
qh: धारावाही चालक में दो बिंदुओं के बीच विभवांतर को एक बिंदु से दूसरे बिंदु तक इकाई आवेश को ले जाने के लिए किए गए कार्य के रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है। इसके एसआई (SI) मात्रक वोल्ट (V) का वैकल्पिक आयामी विन्यास क्या है?
o: 1 V = 1 Watt hour per Second
1 V = 1 Coulomb / 1 Second
1 V = 1 Newton meter per Ampere
1 V = 1 Joule per Coulomb (1 J/C)
e: Concept: Volt, potential difference ka SI unit hai. Potential difference ki definition hai: 1 coulomb charge ko ek bindu se doosre tak le jaane me kitna kaam hota hai. Isliye 1 volt = 1 joule / 1 coulomb (J/C). Coulomb / second to ampere hota hai, watt-hour energy ka unit hai, aur newton-metre kaam ka unit hai. Ye dimensional relationship yaad rakho kyunki exam me directly poocha jata hai. Exam point: '1 V = 1 J/C = 1 watt/ampere'.

qe: A voltmeter is an instrument deployed to track the electric potential difference between two specific points in a circuit. To accomplish this, how must it be geometrically configured relative to those points?
qh: एक वोल्टमीटर एक ऐसा उपकरण है जिसे सर्किट में दो विशिष्ट बिंदुओं के बीच विद्युत विभवांतर को मापने के लिए तैनात किया जाता है। इसे प्राप्त करने के लिए, इसे उन बिंदुओं के सापेक्ष ज्यामितीय रूप से कैसे कॉन्फ़िगर किया जाना चाहिए?
o: It must be connected in series directly into the main loop track.
It must be wrapped as a non-conducting shield around the resistor substrate.
It is connected in series only when the total resistance tends to infinity.
It is always connected in parallel across the points between which the potential difference is to be measured.
e: Concept: Voltmeter do binduon ke beech ka potential difference (voltage) naapna hai, isliye usko un dono binduon ke across, yaani parallel me lagate hain. Uska resistance bahut zyada (ideal: infinite) rakha jata hai taaki wo sirf voltage padhe aur circuit me se koi ahem current kheench kar usko disturb na kare. Agar voltmeter ko series me lagaya jaye to uske high resistance ki wajah se circuit ka current lagbhag band ho jayega. Exam point: 'Voltmeter = parallel me, high resistance'.

qe: Ohm’s law states that the potential difference across the ends of a metallic resistor is directly proportional to the current traversing it. What primary ambient physical condition must be kept strictly constant for this proportionality to remain valid?
qh: ओह्म का नियम बताता है कि एक धात्विक प्रतिरोधक के सिरों पर विभवांतर इसके माध्यम से गुजरने वाली धारा के सीधे समानुपाती होता है। इस समानुपात के मान्य रहने के लिए किस प्राथमिक परिवेशी भौतिक स्थिति को कड़ाई से स्थिर रखा जाना चाहिए?
o: The cross-sectional base area of the target resistor.
The temperature of the conductor must remain the same.
The total length of the connecting wire loop.
The absolute atmospheric pressure surrounding the circuit matrix.
e: Concept: Ohm's law kehta hai V = IR, jahan V potential difference, I current aur R resistance hai, meaning V aur I directly proportional hain jab R constant ho. Resistance khud material ke taapman (temperature) par nirbhar karta hai, isliye law sirf tab sahi chalta hai jab temperature gaye-garmi me constant rakhi jaye; temperature badhne par metal ki resistance badal jaati hai aur proportionality toot jaati hai. Isliye temperature constant hona zaroori hai. Baaki options is law se seedha juda nahi. Exam point: 'Ohm's law valid sirf constant temperature par'.

qe: The resistance (R) of a uniform material conductor is dictated by its structural dimensions. According to electro-physics laws, the resistance depends:
qh: एक समान सामग्री के चालक का प्रतिरोध (R) उसकी संरचनात्मक विमाओं (dimensions) द्वारा तय होता है। विद्युत-भौतिकी के नियमों के अनुसार, प्रतिरोध किस पर निर्भर करता है?
o: Exclusively on the time duration for which the current is maintained.
Directly on its cross-sectional area and inversely on its length parameter.
Directly on its length, inversely on its area of cross-section, and on the nature of the material.
Symmetrically on the square of both its length and area vectors.
e: Concept: Kisi bhi conductor (wire) ka resistance teen cheezon par nirbhar karta hai: lambai (length l) ke saath directly - lambi wire me zyada resistance; cross-section area (A) ke saath inversely - moti wire me kam resistance; aur material ke nature (rho) ke saath - jaise copper ka kam, nichrome ka zyada. Formula: R = rho * l / A. Baaki teen options me area-length ka ulta sambandh ya time par nirbharta bataayi gayi hai jo galat hai. Exam point: 'R = rho*l/A; length se direct, area se ulta sambandh'.

qe: When three resistors R1, R2, and R3 are connected end to end in a series circuit configuration, what parameter remains strictly constant across each individual component?
qh: जब तीन प्रतिरोधक R1, R2, और R3 एक श्रेणी सर्किट (series circuit) विन्यास में एक छोर से दूसरे छोर तक जुड़े होते हैं, तो प्रत्येक व्यक्तिगत घटक पर कौन सा पैरामीटर कड़ाई से स्थिर रहता है?
o: The resistivity factor varies inversely with the position index.
The electric current passing through each resistor is exactly the same.
The total power dissipated by each substrate vanishes symmetrically.
The potential difference across each resistor is identical.
e: Concept: Series circuit ek hi raste wala pura loop hai - sabhi resistors se guzarne wala current wahi hota hai kyunki charge kahin ruk nahi sakta aur beech me bang nahi hai. Isliye current i har resistor me same rehta hai, jabki voltage alag-alag resistors par unki resistance ke hisaab se bant jata hai. Isi kaaran series circuit me current constant hota hai. Baaki options me potential difference ya power ka same hona galat hai, wo parallel ki baat hai. Exam point: 'Series me current same, voltage divide'.

qe: When multiple resistors are connected end to end in series, the total potential difference (V) across the combination relates to individual component potential differences as:
qh: जब कई प्रतिरोधक श्रेणी में एक छोर से दूसरे छोर तक जुड़े होते हैं, तो संयोजन पर कुल विभवांतर (V) व्यक्तिगत घटक विभवांतरों से किस प्रकार संबंधित होता है?
o: The total value varies inversely with the equivalent resistance parameter.
The net potential difference drops to zero to maintain charge conservation.
The total potential difference is equal to the sum of potential differences across the individual resistors (V = V1 + V2 + V3).
The total potential difference is the geometric mean of components.
e: Concept: Series circuit me jatil (total) voltage har component ke voltage ka sum hota hai, kyunki charges jo cell se energy lete hain, wo har resistor me thoda-thoda energy kharch karte hain. Isliye V = V1 + V2 + V3. Dhyaan do: current sab me same rehta hai par voltage ka bantwara resistance ke anupat hota hai. Geometric mean, inverse ya zero wale options galat hain. Exam point: 'Series: V = V1 + V2 + V3 (aur R = R1 + R2 + R3)'.

qe: Why is it practically impossible or highly impracticable to connect an electric lighting bulb and a high-power electric room heater in a single series circuit loop?
qh: एक सिंगल श्रेणी सर्किट (series circuit) लूप में एक इलेक्ट्रिक लाइटिंग बल्ब और एक हाई-पावर इलेक्ट्रिक रूम हीटर को जोड़ना व्यावहारिक रूप से असंभव या अत्यधिक अव्यावहारिक क्यों है?
o: Because the series connection causes an immediate short circuit at the cell terminals.
Because they require electric currents of widely different values to operate properly, which a series circuit cannot provide since current is constant.
Because the series configuration transforms the voltage into an alternating current mode.
Because the combined resistivity of the alloy matrix drops to absolute zero.
e: Concept: Aksar bulb (patla filament, kam current) aur room heater (moti coil, bahut zyada current) ko series me nahi jodte kyunki series circuit me current har jagah same hota hai - bus ke jaisa ek hi raftaar sbhi ko milti hai. Heater ko apni power (jisme zyada current chahiye) nahi mil paayegi aur bulb par voltage sum banane ke kaaran zyada voltage gir jayega. Isliye dono ko unki zaroorat ka alag current de hi nahi sakte. Doosre options me short-circuit ya AC ban jaana galat hai. Exam point: 'Series me current same rehne ke kaaran bade/small appliances saath nahi chal sakte'.

qe: What is a major structural disadvantage of using a series circuit configuration for domestic appliances in household wiring?
qh: घरेलू तारों में घरेलू उपकरणों के लिए श्रेणी सर्किट विन्यास (series circuit configuration) का उपयोग करने का एक प्रमुख संरचनात्मक नुकसान क्या है?
o: The total power consumed becomes strictly independent of the number of appliances.
The series configuration reverses the charge vectors randomly over time.
The total equivalent resistance drops too low, drawing dangerous currents.
When one component fails, the circuit is broken anywhere and none of the other components work.
e: Concept: Gharo me series wiring ka sabse bada nugsh ye hai ki current ka ek hi loop hota hai, isliye agar kisi bhi ek component (bulb, fuse) me fault aaye to pura circuit toot jata hai aur baaki saare appliances band ho jaate hain. Aaj kal gharo me parallel wiring hoti hai, jisme har appliance ko apni alag branch par poori voltage (220 V) milti hai aur ek kharab hone se baaki chalte rehte hain. Baaki options me resistance kam hona ya charge vector palatna - ye galat hain. Exam point: 'Series ka nuksaan = ek fail to sab fail; parallel me alag-alag circuits'.

qe: In a parallel circuit configuration, several resistors are connected simultaneously across two common nodes. What parameter remains identical across all these parallel branches?
qh: एक समानांतर सर्किट विन्यास (parallel circuit configuration) में, कई प्रतिरोधक दो सामान्य नोड्स पर एक साथ जुड़े होते हैं। इन सभी समानांतर शाखाओं में कौन सा पैरामीटर समान रहता है?
o: The electric potential difference across its ends is the same for all resistors.
The individual power dissipation factor scales linearly with the resistance.
The current traversing each separate branch is identical.
The net equivalent resistance becomes the sum of individual blocks.
e: Concept: Parallel circuit me saare resistors ke sire do common nodes par jude hote hain, isliye har resistor ko same potential difference (voltage) milta hai. Current unme alag-alag ho sakta hai (kam resistance wale branch me zyada) aur total current branches ke current ka sum hota hai. Isi ko dekhkar gharo ki wiring parallel me hoti hai taaki sab appliances ko 220 V mile. Baaki options me current ya resistance ka same hona galat hai. Exam point: 'Parallel me voltage same, current divide'.

qe: When multiple electrical gadgets with widely different internal resistances are connected in a parallel configuration, the net total resistance (Rp) of the system:
qh: जब व्यापक रूप से भिन्न आंतरिक प्रतिरोधों वाले कई विद्युत उपकरणों को एक समानांतर विन्यास में जोड़ा जाता है, तो प्रणाली का नेट कुल प्रतिरोध (Rp):
o: Is decreased according to the reciprocal relation 1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3, making it smaller than the smallest individual resistance.
Becomes independent of the material composition parameters of the conductors.
Stays completely equal to the algebraic average of the component vectors.
Increases significantly beyond the highest resistance value connected.
e: Concept: Parallel me net resistance ka formula 1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3 hota hai, isliye Rp hamesha sabse chhoti individual resistance se bhi kam hota hai. Kyun? Kyunki har naya resistor ek naya raasta de deta hai jisse charge ko jaana aasan ho jata hai - jaise kai darwaaze khol dene par bheed tez nikal jaati hai. Iski wajah se ghar me parallel branches badhne par main current badh jata hai. Baaki options me resistance badh jaana ya average lena galat hai. Exam point: 'Parallel: Rp < sabse chhoti resistance'.

qe: When an electric current is maintained continuously through a purely resistive circuit configuration consisting of resistors only connected to a battery, what happens to the electrical energy expended by the source?
qh: जब एक बैटरी से जुड़े केवल प्रतिरोधकों वाले विशुद्ध रूप से प्रतिरोधी सर्किट विन्यास (purely resistive circuit configuration) के माध्यम से लगातार विद्युत धारा बनाए रखी जाती है, तो स्रोत द्वारा खर्च की गई विद्युत ऊर्जा का क्या होता है?
o: The energy is stored permanently as electro-chemical potential inside the resistor matrix.
The source energy continually gets dissipated entirely in the form of heat.
The energy collapses into an imaginary field vector normal to the loop plane.
The energy transforms into non-zero mass cosmic particle fields.
e: Concept: Purely resistive circuit me sirf battery aur resistor hote hain - koi motor ya fan nahi jo energy ko kisi aur roop me badle. Isliye source ki di hui poori vidyut energy resistor me lagatar heat (ushma) ke roop me kharch ho jaati hai; resistor garam hota hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki bulb, heater aur fuse sab garam hote hain. Doosre options me energy ka mass me badalna ya imaginary field - ye sab physics ke against hain. Exam point: 'Pure resistor me energy poora heat me badalti hai (Joule heating)'.

qe: Joule’s law of heating defines the heat (H) generated in a conductor of resistance R carrying a current I for a time duration t as H = I^2*R*t. This law mathematically implies that for a given fixed resistance, the heat produced is directly proportional to:
qh: जूल के तापन का नियम (H = I^2*R*t) प्रतिरोध R के चालक में समय अवधि t के लिए धारा I प्रवाहित होने पर उत्पन्न ऊष्मा (H) को परिभाषित करता है। यह नियम गणितीय रूप से दर्शाता है कि एक निश्चित प्रतिरोध के लिए उत्पन्न ऊष्मा किसके सीधे समानुपाती होती है?
o: The square of the electric current (I^2).
The linear inverse of the elapsed time coordinate.
The square root of the electric potential difference.
The total macroscopic mass of the metallic core wire.
e: Concept: Joule ke ushma niyam ka formula H = I^2 * R * t hai. Iska matlab: agar resistance aur time fix ho, to ushma (heat) sabse zyada 'current ka square' par nirbhar karta hai - current dugna karne par heat chaar guna ho jata hai. Yahi kaaran hai ki thoda-sa zyada current bhi wire ko bahut garam kar deta hai. Baaki options me square root ya time ka ulta sambandh galat hain. Exam point: 'H = I^2Rt; current ka square sabse bada factor'.

qe: In a standard electric incandescent light bulb, the filament must get extremely hot to emit visible light without melting. What strong metal is deployed for making bulb filaments, and what is its approximate melting point?
qh: एक मानक तापदीप्त (incandescent) विद्युत बल्ब में, फिलामेंट को बिना पिघले दृश्य प्रकाश उत्सर्जित करने के लिए अत्यधिक गर्म होना चाहिए। बल्ब फिलामेंट बनाने के लिए किस मजबूत धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है, और इसका अनुमानित गलनांक (melting point) क्या है?
o: Tungsten, with an extremely high melting point of 3380 degrees C.
Copper, with a melting point of 1085 degrees C.
Lead-tin alloy, with a low melting point of 183 degrees C.
Aluminium, with a melting point of 660 degrees C.
e: Concept: Bulb ka filament udne tak bahut garam ho kar roshni deta hai, isliye wo aise dhatu ka banate hain jiska melting point bahut zyada ho. Tungsten (W) ka melting point lagbhag 3380 degree C hai, jo sabhi dhatuon me sabse zyada hai, isliye wo 2000-3000 C par bhi safe rehta hai. Copper, aluminium, lead-tin jaise options kam melting point ke hain - wo garam hote hi pighal jayenge. Exam point: 'Bulb filament = tungsten (sabse zyada melting point 3380 C)'.

qe: To prolong the operating lifespan of the high-temperature filament inside an electric light bulb, the glass shell is evacuated and usually back-filled with which chemically inactive gases?
qh: एक विद्युत प्रकाश बल्ब के भीतर उच्च तापमान वाले फिलामेंट के परिचालन जीवनकाल को बढ़ाने के लिए, कांच के आवरण को खाली किया जाता है और आमतौर पर किन रासायनिक रूप से निष्क्रिय गैसों से भरा जाता है?
o: Chlorine and fluorine active halogen vapours.
Pure highly reactive Oxygen and Hydrogen gas mixtures.
Chemically inactive nitrogen and argon gases.
Carbon dioxide and carbon monoxide trace elements.
e: Concept: Bahut garam filament hawa ki oxygen se mil kar turant jal (oxidise ho kar) toot jayega, isliye bulb ke andar ki hawa nikaal kar (vacuum) uski jagah chemical inactive gases - nitrogen aur argon - bhar di jaati hain. Ye noble/inert gases filament ke saath react nahi karti, but at the same time bulb ke andar ka pressure sambhale rakhti hain jisse filament tikta hai. Oxygen/hydrogen jaisi active gases ya chlorine wale options juice jalane wale hain. Exam point: 'Bulb me inert gas bharo (N2 + Ar) taaki filament oxidise na ho'.

qe: An electric safety fuse protects household circuits and delicate appliances from dangerously high currents. According to physics layouts, how is the fuse placed relative to the device it protects?
qh: एक विद्युत सुरक्षा फ्यूज (electric safety fuse) घरेलू सर्किट और नाजुक उपकरणों को खतरनाक रूप से उच्च धाराओं से बचाता है। भौतिकी के अनुसार, फ्यूज को उस उपकरण के सापेक्ष कैसे रखा जाता है जिसकी वह सुरक्षा करता है?
o: The fuse is always connected in parallel across the device.
The fuse is mounted as an isolated external ground plane.
The fuse configuration is randomized depending on the building area.
The fuse is placed in series with the device.
e: Concept: Fuse ek majboot suraksha-taara (wire) hota hai jisme se circuit ka pura current guzarta hai, isliye fuse hamesha us device ke series me lagta hai aur usi current ko sahan karta hai. Agar wo parallel me lagega to usme se sirf bahut kam current guzarega (kyunki high resistance path) aur wo kabhi fatega hi nahi - fazool ho jayega. Isi design ka matlab hai ki koi bhi extra current device me jaane se pehle fuse par pahunche aise lagana. Exam point: 'Fuse = hamesha series me, device ki suraksha ke liye'.

qe: What occurs physically to a safety fuse wire when an abnormally high electric current, exceeding its rated specified value, passes through the circuit loop?
qh: जब सर्किट लूप के माध्यम से एक असामान्य रूप से उच्च विद्युत धारा, जो इसके निर्धारित निर्दिष्ट मान से अधिक है, गुजरती है, तो सुरक्षा फ्यूज तार के साथ भौतिक रूप से क्या होता है?
o: Its resistance drops to zero, allowing the high current to pass safely.
The fuse wire undergoes mechanical polarization, transforming into a magnet.
The temperature of the fuse wire increases due to Joule heating, melting the wire and breaking the circuit open.
The fuse wire expands its cross-sectional area to accommodate the charge flux.
e: Concept: Fuse wire aise padarth (tin, lead ya alloy) ka banta hai jiska melting point kam hota hai par resistance theek-thak hota hai. Jab current apni rated value se zyada ho jata hai, to Joule heating (H = I^2Rt) ke kaaran fuse ki wire ka temperature bahut tez badhta hai, wo catch karke pighal jaati hai aur circuit toot jata hai (open ho jata hai) - isse sab devices bach jate hain. Isliye high current aage nahi pahunch paata. Doosre options me resistance zero ho jana ya magnet ban jana galat hai. Exam point: 'Fuse high current par pighal kar circuit tod deta hai'.

qe: The SI unit of electric power (P) is the Watt (W). According to electro-physics metrics, one Watt of power is consumed by a device when:
qh: विद्युत शक्ति (P) का एसआई (SI) मात्रक वाट (W) है। विद्युत-भौतिकी के मानदंडों के अनुसार, किसी उपकरण द्वारा एक वाट शक्ति की खपत तब की जाती है जब:
o: It carries 1 Coulomb of charge operating for a duration of 1 Hour.
It carries 1 A of current when operated at a potential difference of 1 V (1 W = 1 V * 1 A).
Its internal resistance equals exactly 1 Ohm at absolute zero temperature.
The total heat energy dissipated scales to 3.6 * 10^6 Joules.
e: Concept: Power ka matlab 'kitni tezi se energy kharch ho rahi hai' hai, matlab P = W/t. Ek watt power tab hoti hai jab koi device 1 volt ke potential difference par 1 ampere current leta hai, yaani 1 W = 1 V * 1 A = 1 J/s. Isliye watt, volt aur ampere ka combination hai (P = VI). Coulomb-hour ya 1 ohm resistance par power ka hone wala option galat hain; 3.6*10^6 joule to 1 kWh (commercial unit) ki value hai. Exam point: '1 W = 1 V * 1 A = 1 J/s'.

qe: The unit 'Watt' is extremely small for industrial and commercial billing tracking. What is the standard commercial unit of electrical energy commonly known as a 'unit'?
qh: औद्योगिक और व्यावसायिक बिलिंग ट्रैकिंग के लिए 'वाट' मात्रक अत्यंत छोटा है। विद्युत ऊर्जा का मानक व्यावसायिक मात्रक क्या है जिसे आमतौर पर 'यूनिट' (unit) कहा जाता है?
o: The Volt-Ampere second (V A s).
The kilowatt hour (kWh).
The Ampere hour rating field.
The Joule per second (J/s).
e: Concept: Watt bahut chhota unit hai - ek 100 W ka bulb 1 second me sirf 100 joule kharch karta hai, isliye bijli ki bade paimane ki khapat (ghar, factory) ko wadhane ke liye kilowatt-hour (kWh) use karte hain. 1 kWh ka matlab: 1 kilowatt (1000 W) ka load 1 ghante tak chalna. Bijli ke meter isi kWh ko gin-te hain aur isi par bill banta hai; isi liye ise ghar gorha 'unit' kehte hain. Volt-ampere-second = joule, J/s = watt, ampere-hour = charge - ye alag hain. Exam point: 'Commercial unit = kWh (1 unit)'.

qe: When evaluating the commercial electrical energy consumption conversion, one kilowatt-hour (1 kWh) corresponds precisely to how many Joules (J) of energy?
qh: व्यावसायिक विद्युत ऊर्जा खपत रूपांतरण का मूल्यांकन करते समय, एक किलोवाट-घंटा (1 kWh) सटीक रूप से कितने जूल (J) ऊर्जा के बराबर होता है?
o: 1 kWh = 220 J
1 kWh = 1000 J
e: Concept: kWh ko joule me badalna ek khaas conversion hai: 1 kWh = 1000 watt * 3600 second = 3,600,000 J, yaani 3.6 * 10^6 J. Isliye bijli bill me '1 unit' ka matlab hota hai 36 lakh joule energy. Doosre options: 1000 J sirf 1 kJ hai, 220 J kuch nahi, aur 1.6*10^-19 J ek electron ki energy (charge) ki tarah ki chhoti value hai. Exam point: '1 kWh = 3.6 * 10^6 J'. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1 kWh = 3.6 * 10^6 Joules... hi milti hai. Is vishay ke ulte prashn bhi poochhe jaate hain, isliye dono taraf ka tathya saaf karna zaroori hai.

qe: A widespread misconception among consumers is that electrons are consumed or used up when an appliance operates in an electric circuit. What is the actual physical fact regarding what we pay the electricity company for?
qh: उपभोक्ताओं के बीच एक व्यापक गलत धारणा यह है कि जब कोई उपकरण इलेक्ट्रिक सर्किट में काम करता है तो इलेक्ट्रॉन समाप्त या उपभोग हो जाते हैं। हम बिजली कंपनी को वास्तव में किस चीज के लिए भुगतान करते हैं, इसके संबंध में वास्तविक भौतिक तथ्य क्या है?
o: We pay for the oxidation transformation of the copper wire atoms.
We pay for the static magnetic charge fields accumulated inside the house walls.
We pay for the mass weight of new electrons injected into the appliance.
We pay for the energy used to move electrons through the electric gadgets like electric bulb, fan and engines.
e: Concept: Appliance chalne se electron 'khatam' nahi hote - wo sirf circuit me ghoomte hain aur wapas tar (source) me chale jate hain. Hamare paise asal me us 'energy' ke liye lagte hain jo source electrons ko dhakka dene aur unhe load me kaam karane me kharch karti hai (aur ant me heat/light/rotation me badal jaati hai). Isi liye bijli ke meter energy (kWh) ginte hain, electron ke bhaar ya naye electron ka paisa nahi lete. Baaki teen options me electron ka mass, magnetic charge field ya copper ka oxidation ganwana galat hai. Exam point: 'Hum bijli me energy ke liye paisa dete hain, electron ke liye nahi'.

qe: The metric unit of electric charge is the Coulomb (C). According to physics standards, one Coulomb of charge is equivalent to the collective charge contained in approximately how many electrons?
qh: विद्युत आवेश का मात्रक कूलॉम (C) है। भौतिकी के मानकों के अनुसार, एक कूलॉम आवेश लगभग कितने इलेक्ट्रॉनों में निहित सामूहिक आवेश के बराबर होता है?
o: Exactly 1000 electrons per cubic meter.
Nearly 1.6 * 10^-19 electrons.
An infinite number of electrons.
Nearly 6 * 10^18 electrons.
e: Concept: Coulomb, charge ka SI unit hai. Ek Coulomb ka matlab hai lagbhag 6 * 10^18 electrons ka total charge (the exact value 6.25 * 10^18 hoti hai). Har electron par charge -1.6 * 10^-19 C hota hai, isliye 1 C ke liye chahiye 1/1.6*10^-19 = ~6.25*10^18 electrons - yahi bada aankdaa yaad rakho. 1.6*10^-19 to ek electron ka charge hai (ulta), infinite electrons galat hai. Exam point: '1 C = 1/(1.6*10^-19) = 6.25*10^18 electrons'.

qe: A metallic conductor has a uniform structural resistance (R). If this conductor is stretched uniformly to double its original length while keeping its material mass constant, what happens to its resistance?
qh: एक धात्विक चालक का एकसमान संरचनात्मक प्रतिरोध (R) होता है। यदि इस चालक को इसकी सामग्री के द्रव्यमान को स्थिर रखते हुए इसकी मूल लंबाई से दोगुना समान रूप से खींचा जाता है, तो इसके प्रतिरोध का क्या होता है?
o: The resistance increases to four times its original value (4R).
The resistance stays completely identical at R.
The resistivity factor collapses to absolute zero dynamically.
The resistance decreases precisely to one-half (R/2).
e: Concept: Jab wire ko kheencha jata hai to volume same rehta hai, isliye lambai (l) dugni hone par cross-section area (A) aadhi ho jaati hai (volume = l * A constant). Resistance formula R = rho*l/A me l dugna aur A aadha karne par R chaar guna (4R) ho jaata hai. Har star (stretched) wire ko lamba aur patla dono hone ke kaaran resistance bahut tezi se badhta hai. Do'srey options (same ya aadha) volume constant wale neeyam ko todte hain. Exam point: 'Wire double length par kheencha to R = 4R'.

qe: What is the standard 'Voltage' and 'Frequency' of domestic AC power in Indian households?
qh: भारतीय घरों में घरेलू एसी बिजली का मानक 'वोल्टेज' और 'आवृत्ति' क्या है?
e: Concept: Bharat me gharo ki AC supply ka standard voltage 220 V aur frequency 50 Hz hai (manak range 220-230 V). Iska matlab hai ki current apni disha 1 second me 100 baar badalta hai (50 cycle, shakal - pos/neg - dono). America jaise desh 110-120 V, 60 Hz use karte hain. Baaki options me 110V/60Hz (US style), 440V (industrial 3-phase), ya 60Hz (US frequency) galat hain. Exam point: 'India: 220 V, 50 Hz (domestic AC)'. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab 220V, 50Hz hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: Which wire in household electrical wiring carries dangerous potential and must have the switch connected to it?
qh: घरेलू विद्युत तारों में कौन सा तार खतरनाक विभव ले जाता है और स्विच को हमेशा किससे जोड़ा जाना चाहिए?
o: Ground wire
Neutral wire
Phase / Live wire
Earth wire
e: Concept: Ghar ki wiring me teen tar hote hain - live (phase), neutral aur earth. Live (phase) wire me hi dangerous high potential hota hai, isliye switch hamesha live wire me lagaya jata hai. Aisa is liye ki jab switch off ho to device pura izole (dead) ho jaye; agar switch neutral me laga ho to bulb band hote hue bhi usme live potential reh jayega aur chhoote hi current lag sakta hai - maintenance karte samay wo khatarnak hai. Baaki options me neutral/earth par potential zero rehta hai. Exam point: 'Switch hamesha live (phase) wire me'.

qe: What is the primary objective of providing 'Earthing' in household installations?
qh: घरेलू उपकरणों में 'अर्थिंग' (Earthing) प्रदान करने का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To stabilize utility frequency
To increase appliance wattage
Safety against electric shock
To save electricity consumption
e: Concept: Earthing ka matlab hai appliance ke dhatu (metal) body ko ek zameen me gaadi gayi (ground) tar se jodna. Agar kahin insulation fail ho kar live wire body se chhoo jaye, to current sabse aasan rasta (low resistance) Lete hue seedha zameen me chala jata hai, aur device ki body live nahi hoti; agar koi chhoo le to kuch nahi hota (aur fuse/MCB turant ud jata hai). Isliye earthing ka mukhya kaam electric shock se bachav hai, bijli bachana ya watt badhana nahi. Exam point: 'Earthing = electric shock se suraksha (metal body ko ground karna)'.

qe: According to the modern international color coding standard for flexible electrical cords, what color is assigned to the 'Neutral' wire?
qh: फ्लेक्सिबल विद्युत तारों के लिए आधुनिक अंतरराष्ट्रीय रंग कोड के अनुसार, 'न्यूट्रल' तार को कौन सा रंग दिया गया है?
o: Black
Green / Yellow
Blue
Brown
e: Concept: Aaj ke manak (standard colour code) ke hisaab se flexible wire me neutral tar ki colour blue hoti hai; live (phase) brown ya red, aur earth green ya peeli (yellow) hoti hai. Isi liye kaam karne se pehle colour dekh kar pata chalta hai ki kaun-sa tar chhoona khatarnak hai. Doosre options me black kuch deshon me (purane code me) hota hai, par international manak me neutral = blue hai. Exam point: 'Neutral = blue; Phase = brown/red; Earth = green/yellow'.

qe: What defines a physical 'Short Circuit' condition in an electrical network?
qh: विद्युत परिपथ में 'शॉर्ट सर्किट' की स्थिति को क्या परिभाषित करता है?
o: Current traveling through an abnormally high resistance loop
Complete disconnection of all conducting paths
Reversal of supply polarity at constant impedance
Current bypassing the intended load through a path of almost zero resistance
e: Concept: Short circuit ka matlab hai current ka kisi aisi raste par behna jahan resistance lagbhag zero ho aur koi load (appliance) na ho. Aise halat me Ohm's law (I = V/R) ke hisaab se current bahut zyada ho jata hai, wire garam ho kar aag pakad sakti hai. Ye ghar me tab hota hai jab live aur neutral bina load ke mil jayein (insulation yaad toota ya atki hui). Baaki options me high resistance path ya circuit ka tootna galat hain. Exam point: 'Short circuit = zero-resistance raste se high current'.

qe: Which material is predominantly used to construct heating elements in appliances like electric irons and heaters?
qh: इलेक्ट्रिक आयरन और हीटर जैसे उपकरणों में हीटिंग एलिमेंट बनाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से किस सामग्री का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Silver
Tungsten
Pure Copper
Nichrome
e: Concept: Heater, iron, toaster jaisi cheezon ki coil ko aisi dhatu-mishran (alloy) se banate hain jiska resistance bahut zyada ho aur garam hone par bhi oxidise na ho. Nichrome (nickel + chromium + iron ka alloy) sabse zyada use hota hai - iski resistance high hoti hai aur 1000 degree C tak bhi kharab nahi hoti. Tungsten bulb filament ke liye hota hai (bahut mahanga aur brittle), copper-silver ki resistance bahut kam hai isliye wo garam nahi hote. Exam point: 'Heating element = nichrome (high resistance alloy)'.

qe: The 'Specific Resistance' (Resistivity) of a material depends only on its temperature and nature, and is strictly independent of its:
qh: किसी पदार्थ का 'विशिष्ट प्रतिरोध' (प्रतिरोधकता) केवल उसके तापमान और प्रकृति पर निर्भर करता है, और यह पूरी तरह से स्वतंत्र है:
o: Operating temperature
Chemical composition
Physical dimensions (Length and cross-sectional area)
Microscopic electron density
e: Concept: Kisi padarth ki resistivity (specific resistance) us padarth ki material property hoti hai, jo sirf uski composition (nature) aur temperature par nirbhar karti hai - wire lambi/moti karne se resistivity nahi badalti, sirf resistance badalta hai. Isliye resistivity wire ke aakaar (length aur cross-sectional area) se poori tarah independent hoti hai, par material (copper ya nichrome) badalne par badal jaati hai. Isi liye copper ki wire chahe chhoti ho ya badi, uska rho same rehta hai. Exam point: 'Resistivity = material ka property; wire ke size par nirbhar nahi'.

qe: What is the designated SI unit of Electrical Resistivity?
qh: विद्युत प्रतिरोधकता (Resistivity) का निर्दिष्ट एसआई (SI) मात्रक क्या है?
o: Ohm
Siemens per meter
Volt per Ampere
Ohm-meter
e: Concept: Resistance ka SI unit ohm hai, par resistivity (specific resistance) lambai * resistance / area se nikalne par uska unit ohm-metre hota hai. Isliye ohmmeter ya ohm nahi, ohm-metre (ohm-m) likhna hota hai - jaise copper ki resistivity lagbhag 1.7*10^-8 ohm-m hoti hai. Siemens/metre to conductivity ka unit hai (resistance ka ulta), aur volt/ampere wapas ohm hi hai. Exam point: 'Resistivity ka unit = ohm-metre (ohm*m)'. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Ohm-meter hi hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: Which logic gate outputs a binary 0 only when every one of its input terminals receives binary 1?
qh: कौन सा लॉजिक गेट 0 केवल तभी आउटपुट देता है जब उसके सभी इनपुट टर्मिनल 1 हों?
o: NAND gate
AND gate
OR gate
NOR gate
e: Concept: Logic gate digital circuits ke building block hain. NAND gate 'NOT of AND' hai: AND gate tabhi 1 deta hai jab sabhi inputs 1 hon; NAND usse ulta karne ke kaaran sabhi inputs 1 hone par output 0 deta hai, aur baaki kisi bhi case me 1 deta hai. Isi tarah NOR gate sabhi inputs 0 par hi 1 deta hai. Isliye 'sab inputs 1 par output 0' NAND ki pehchaan hai. AND gate 'sab 1 par 1' deta hai, OR/NOR ke sambandh alag hain. Exam point: 'NAND = AND ka ulta (sab 1 par 0)'.

qe: What is the equivalent electrical power output of a machine rated at 2 Horsepower (HP) in Watts?
qh: 2 हॉर्सपावर (HP) रेटेड मशीन का वाट (Watts) में समतुल्य विद्युत शक्ति आउटपुट क्या है?
e: Concept: Horsepower ek power ka purana (British) unit hai jo motors, engines aur pumps ke rating me chalta hai. 1 horsepower = 746 watt hota hai (metric me 735.5 W). Isliye 2 HP = 2 * 746 = 1492 W. Aam taur par log isko 1500 W maan lete hain (round figure), par exact value se sawal poochte hain to 1492 W sahi hota hai. Doosre options: 746 W sirf 1 HP hai, 1000 W kuch aur standard hai (1 kW), 1500 W round kiya hua jawab hai. Exam point: '1 HP = 746 W, isliye 2 HP = 1492 W'.
